title: Manu Joseph: Christopher Nolan's fame precedes his movies but why is the maker of 'The Odyssey' so famous?
description: The British director of blockbusters such as 'Inception' and 'Interstellar' isn’t just talented. Part of the reason his films have gained a cult following is that they are abstract enough for people to see what they want in his work. Does that qualify it as arthouse cinema?
